method: Only promote a scheduler-support endpoint when an independent original-ROM execution attains it. Affine invariants translate validated scores into accepted-command counts without counting attempted pulses.

calculation.scope: ROM-authenticated policy room costs and audited scheduler support. Scalar extrema need attaining executions; verified affine invariants hold over the entire support.

fresh_watch.method: Packaged ROM-state selector, original CPU/player, IRQ guidance, 8ms controller polling, 17ms SDL input delivery with varied phases, 100ms input holds. Mode 0 tests Off selecting Max score for automation.
fresh_watch.limitations: Headless input timing model; not a physical Android device test. No claim of all retry contexts or global optimality.
